item.title: Pokémon: new League Cup and League Challenge prizes from 1 December 2026
item.summary: From Tuesday 1 December 2026, Pokémon TCG League Cup top finishers in each age division get a Mega Evolution—Delta Reign playmat, and Pokémon VGC and Pokémon GO top finishers get an acrylic standee of the Sky High Pokémon. At select Play! Pokémon Stores, players in Friendly Tournaments, League Challenges and League Cups can also get Play! Pokémon-stamped Cinderace, Lunatone and Mega Signal promo cards.

details.heading: League Cup prizes
items: Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign playmat, one per top finisher in each age division
Pokémon VGC: acrylic standee of the Sky High Pokémon for the top finishers in each age division
Pokémon GO: the same standee for the overall top finisher

details.heading: Stamped promo cards (select Play! Pokémon Stores)

source.headline: New Prizes Are Coming to Play! Pokémon Stores in December 2026

item.title: Magic: Pioneer returns to Regional Championships, and 14 Spotlight Series events in 2027
item.summary: The third round of the 2026–27 Regional Championship season (10 April to 23 May 2027) will be Pioneer. From 2027 each Regional Championship season has four rounds instead of three, and there are 14 Magic Spotlight Series events (up from 12), each with a CommandFest alongside. From 2028 a fourth, all-Limited Pro Tour replaces the Limited Championship.

details.heading: Magic Spotlight Series 2027
items: Star Trek (Limited): Minneapolis, US, 9–10 January · Lille, France, 9–10 January
Nauctis (Limited): Zagreb, Croatia, 13–14 March · Toronto, Canada, 20–21 March
Marvel Darkhold Destiny (Modern): Seattle, US, 24–25 April · Beijing, China, 22–23 May
Kamigawa Titanbreach (Limited): Hartford, US, 12–13 June · Shizuoka, Japan, 24–25 July · Montreal, Canada, 24–25 July
Set TBC (Team Limited): Washington, DC, 14–15 August · Utrecht, Netherlands, 4–5 September · Sydney, Australia, 4–5 September
Zhalfir (Pioneer): Valencia, Spain, 16–17 October · Dallas-Fort Worth, US, 23–24 October

details.heading: Prizes
items: $50,000 prize pool at each Spotlight event (Team Limited events: $60,000)
Top 8 players earn Pro Tour invitations (Team Limited: top 4 teams)

source.headline: Everything New for Competitive Play in 2027

item.title: Magic: Werewolf Pack Leader Oracle change and new rules with Star Trek
item.summary: With Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek, released 13 November 2026, Werewolf Pack Leader's last ability now makes it a Werewolf until end of turn, instead of making it stop being a Human. New rules 700.17, 701.72 and 702.196 cover face a dilemma, assimilate and beam me up, and new rule 508.4e supports Kira Nerys, Firebrand letting creatures enter tapped and attacking.

details.heading: Oracle change
items: Werewolf Pack Leader: its {3}{G} ability now ends with "and is a Werewolf" instead of "and isn't a Human"

details.heading: Comprehensive Rules
items: 508.4e (new): creatures entering tapped and attacking through a replacement effect, for Kira Nerys, Firebrand
208.3 (updated): power and toughness of noncreature objects that aren't on the battlefield

source.headline: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek Update Bulletin

item.title: Magic: three commanders banned in Competitive Brawl, no other format changes
item.summary: From 12 October 2026, in Competitive Brawl: Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow; Spider-Man 2099; and Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice are banned as commanders, nine cards are now banned only as a commander, and Nashi, Illusion Gadgeteer is rebalanced. No other format changed. The next announcement is due on 30 November 2026.

details.heading: Now banned only as a commander
No changes
items: Standard, Pioneer, Modern, Legacy, Vintage, Pauper, Alchemy, Historic, Timeless and Brawl

note: The change to Perfectron Hydradrive Dragon applies from the release of Magnificent Maestros on 11 November 2026.
